skillFull: Gains a Headbutt charge at regular intervals. When it has a charge, it searches for nearby obstacles, headbutting away any within range. Headbutting and destroying an obstacle creates Hex Shard Jellies. Level Up for more points for Hex Shard Jellies.
story: Bzzz, bzzz, bzzzz! If you hear the sound of tiny wings, buzzing your way, run! Run NOW! It's the sound of Stinghorn taking flight! Quick-tempered and the fastest bee off the mark, it was Helios Honey Cookie who personally handpicked this one as a scout. Bursting with pride over every mission received from the Supreme Commander, this fearless soldier dives headfirst into even the most dangerous enemy territory without a moment's hesitation. As for that menacing hornet helmet worn on every single deployment... Rumor has it, the reason it never comes off is that the little fella looks too darn cute to intimidate anyone without it.

costumes.name: Rosey Gatekeeper
costumes.info: When a private meeting unfold in the secret garden, Stinghorn stands guard at the entrance's archway. This loyal soldier feels no need to see the roses with its own two eyes. The laughter drifting out on the floral breeze is more than enough to brighten this Pet's day.
